body:

Regards,
Prakash Kulkarni

subject: INV-3601 rate
body:
Hi,

The rate on INV-3601 is ₹14.20 per carton but our PO SPP/4471 was at ₹12.80. On 5,000 cartons that is ₹7,000 extra. Please send a revised invoice; we will release payment once it is corrected.

Anjali Verma

subject: INV-3404 - returned
body:
Dear Team,

Our ERP has rejected INV-3404 as there is no PO reference on it. Without a PO it cannot be booked, so kindly re-issue the invoice quoting our PO number.

Thanks,
Prakash

subject: Fwd: GRN pending - INV-3801
body:

Lakshmi

body:

INV-3302 has been raised for September, but our cold storage lease with you started only from 1st October. The bill should be for October. Please correct the period and resend.

Nikhil Sawant

INV-3204 was already settled on 12/10 by RTGS — ₹1,77,000, UTR HDFCR52026101200345. Please check your books before sending further reminders.

Bikash Bora
